collection: ARTT3005 — Twenty Ways of Looking at a Tap

records.title: The tap, straight on
records.not_captured: the sound it was making while I stood there

records.title: The spout, too close
records.not_captured: the scale — you cannot tell this is a tap and not a building

records.title: Looking up from the basin
records.not_captured: how awkward it was to crouch there, and how long I could hold it

records.title: Running into a glass
records.not_captured: the temperature of the water. It was cold and I can't show that.

records.title: One drip, mid-air
records.not_captured: the next drip, and the one after that. A photograph of a drip is a lie about time.

records.title: The tap at night
records.not_captured: the silence of the flat around it

records.title: Thirty seconds of running water
records.not_captured: the pressure change when the downstairs neighbour flushed. You can almost hear it but not quite.

records.title: What the tap is, in words
records.not_captured: the words I didn't use. Every description is a deletion.

records.title: From the doorway
records.not_captured: the distance. It looks like any tap from here, which is the point.

records.title: Its shadow on the sink
records.not_captured: the shadow kept moving and I only got one version

records.title: With the dishes in the sink
records.not_captured: whose dishes they were, and why they were there

records.title: Wiped dry
records.not_captured: the effort of drying it. A clean tap is a record of labour that the photo erases.

records.title: A hand on the handle
records.not_captured: the grip. How much force it takes. You can't see that.

records.title: The handle, macro
records.not_captured: the wear on it — the little scratches that mean twenty years of hands

records.title: The reflection on the tap
records.not_captured: what the reflection was reflecting. You can see a shape but not what made it.

records.title: The handle, from my point of view
records.not_captured: the angle I had to hold my body at to get this. The photo is still. I was not.

records.title: Morning light
records.not_captured: the time. 7:12am. The photo doesn't say that unless I say it.

records.title: Evening light
records.not_captured: how different it looked and how it's the same tap

records.title: Dry, off, nothing happening
records.not_captured: the fact that it's waiting. Taps wait. You can't photograph waiting.

records.title: The tap, straight on, again
records.not_captured: what changed between this and the first one. Almost nothing. That's the record.
